findings.detail: For newly included recursive paths such as module/src/file.go, historical_guide queries module/AGENTS.md in the superproject's baseline tree. Git cannot traverse the gitlink, so the empty result is treated as expected absence. Review can succeed without mandatory child instructions, with no diagnostic identifying incomplete guidance resolution.
findings.fix: Resolve each child's trusted revision from the parent baseline gitlink and load historical guides from that child's object database recursively. Distinguish absent guides from unavailable historical context and report incomplete coverage when resolution fails.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Checked commands: Recursive guide lookup silently treats unresolved child guidance as absent.

strengths: Missing required child objects preserve Git diagnostics and stop collection.
Recursive path-record writes explicitly propagate failures with path and output-file context.
Concurrent child changes stop collection with an actionable rerun message.
summary: Reviewed the full committed scope for failure propagation, diagnostics and fallbacks; one Important historical-guidance gap remains. Bash syntax checks passed; runtime suites were not run because their fixtures write files.
